kicker.zh-Hans: S 级优化 · 自动配好

title.zh-Hans: 出包时，自动带上社区补丁和金手指
title.en: Community patches and cheats, built in automatically

what.zh-Hans: S2Arm 按你的游戏版本，从社区补丁库里找能用的**满屏补丁、帧率补丁和金手指**，出包时一起打进去。
what.en: S2Arm looks up **full-screen patches, frame-rate patches and cheats** that match your game's version and builds them in when you export.

how.zh-Hans: 不用自己找、自己装。照常点「开始出包」就行，命中的会自动带上。
how.en: Nothing to find or install. Just click Start export as usual; matches are added for you.

where.zh-Hans: 游戏库选一款 → **出包页的金色「S 级优化」卡片**，列出这款命中的每一项和作者。
where.en: Pick a game in the library → the **gold "S-grade" card on the export page** lists every match and its author.

kicker.zh-Hans: S 级优化 · 满屏与帧率
kicker.en: S-grade · Full screen and frame rate

title.en: Fill the screen, double the frame rate

what.zh-Hans: **满屏补丁**按你的屏幕比例铺满、人物不变形；**帧率补丁**让锁 30 帧的游戏跑 60 帧，有 120 帧补丁的在高刷屏上跟到 120。
what.en: **Full-screen patches** fill your screen at its own aspect ratio without stretching; **frame-rate patches** take 30 fps games to 60, and up to 120 on high-refresh displays where a 120 fps patch exists.

how.zh-Hans: 版本对上的满屏、帧率补丁**出包时默认开启**。开着补丁游戏崩了，下次打开会自动关掉出问题的那项。
how.en: Patches that match your version are **on by default**. If a patch crashes the game, the next launch turns that one off for you.

where.zh-Hans: 装到 iPhone、iPad 或在 Mac 上玩都生效。想关：iPhone 在游戏里**齿轮 → 设置 → S 级优化**，Mac 在这款的**启动设置**。
where.en: Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac. To turn one off: on iPhone, **gear → Settings → S-grade** in the game; on Mac, the game's **Launch settings**.

kicker.zh-Hans: S 级优化 · 金手指

title.zh-Hans: 金手指，进游戏逐条打开
title.en: Cheats, one switch at a time

what.zh-Hans: 社区整理好的**金手指**，按你的游戏版本自动配好，出包时一起打进去。
what.en: Community **cheats** matched to your game's version are built in when you export.

how.zh-Hans: 打进去后**默认关**。想用哪条就打开哪条，约 1 秒生效，不用重启游戏。
how.en: They start **off**. Turn on the ones you want; each takes effect in about a second, no restart.

where.zh-Hans: iPhone / iPad：游戏里**点左上角齿轮 → 设置 → S 级优化 → 金手指**。Mac：游戏库里这款的菜单 → **启动设置**。
where.en: iPhone / iPad: in the game, **top-left gear → Settings → S-grade → Cheats**. Mac: the game's menu in the library → **Launch settings**.
